title: Crit. Power

{{For|technical details about Crit. Power mechanics|Combat/Mechanics}} '''Crit. Power''' [[File:Crit. Power.png|24px]] (short for Critical Power) is a [[Combat]] statistic. A critical strike unaffected by Crit. Power does 3x base damage. Crit. Power causes this multiplier to increase so that critical strikes do more damage. ==Increasing Crit. Power== The following items increase Crit. Power. The effect is permanent when the item is equipped. [[Forge#Weapon forging|Forging]] a weapon with [[Jade]]s will increase its natural Crit.
